Theme

Kitchen, meals & drinks

provisions noun

a household’s store of food

also food store, stores, victuals, supplies (of food), the larder

classical

Plaut. Capt. 920: dīcam ut sibi penum alium adōrnet
Cic. N. D. 2.68: est enim omne, quō vēscuntur hominēs, penus (Lewis & Short)

penus, penūs (penī) m./f.

the store of food kept in a house; provisions

Also neuter, penus, penoris and penum. It gives cella penāria, the pantry, and the Penātēs.

Examples

  • dīcam ut sibi penum alium adōrnet, sīquidem sēsē ūtī volet

    I’ll tell him to lay in a second stock of food, if he means to have any for himselfPlaut. Capt. 920

See also pantry, groceries, supply, storeroom, butler.

SourcesLewis & Short: penus

Plautus, Captivi 920.
